Rank with a pinned model/features snapshot and deterministic tie-breaker.

problem.scope: Extend L011 with versioned ranking, stable pagination and freshness watermarks. Published latency targets require deployment measurements; queue throughput alone does not establish fast feed reads.

acceptanceCases.given: Candidates include two equal-score posts, a higher-score candidate whose stored row still says allowed but which the visibility authority no longer returns, and a deleted post.
acceptanceCases.then: Both results are the same two posts in the same tie order; the stale-allowed and deleted candidates are omitted. This proves only the bounded ranking rule.
acceptanceCases.when: Rank twice with the same feature snapshot and current visibility set, reversing the input order.

acceptanceCases.given: Equal-score posts straddle a page boundary and new posts arrive.
acceptanceCases.then: Return each eligible snapshot post once; new publications enter a new session.
acceptanceCases.when: Continue with the same snapshot and full tie tuple.

acceptanceCases.given: An unfollow or deletion happens after candidate materialization.
acceptanceCases.then: The ranker's current visibility check removes it before ranking and output.

acceptanceCases.given: Fan-out stops after only part of the recipient pages.
acceptanceCases.then: Deduplicate replayed inserts and disclose freshness while bounded pull fallback repairs recent omissions.
acceptanceCases.when: Resume workers and request a feed with a lagging watermark.

acceptanceCases.given: A post commits while the fan-out worker is down.
acceptanceCases.then: Posts and the graph remain authoritative; the timeline is regenerated from outbox events and the pinned graph revision without editing either.
acceptanceCases.when: Rebuild a viewer timeline from the outbox.

algorithms.code:
// Stable ranker (n6): visibleNow is the set the visibility authority returns for this viewer and page, never a stored candidate flag.
const ranked=(rows,visibleNow)=>rows.filter(r=>visibleNow.has(r.id)&&!r.deleted).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||b.seq-a.seq||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
guarantees: The code states the bounded decision rule; unimplemented helpers remain pseudocode.
External effects, distributed failure and latency require separate execution evidence.
Compare watermark against publication progress and merge bounded recent pull results.
